After these were completed, I started killing off the initial wood housing. Freeing up the prime real estate and dropping in stone houses along a logical pathway. I was able to do them two at a time, with about 5-10 people in the boarding house at any moment.

I had a mini population boom, so I set them to digging out my first quarry. I got lucky with a bunch of iron so I didn't have to worry about that quite yet. I put down my blacksmith and school as soon as I had the last 2 houses being deconstructed.
